title: MCP roster tool
description: Input and output of the `roster` MCP tool (design/roster.md): every Worker in one read model, projected on read from the Worker registry, the account and enrollment records, the resource ledger, the workflow runs, and the board, never stored. A fact a source could not give is `{unknown: why}`, never a default. The root describes one call (tool, input, structured output); a provider validates the output against `#/$defs/roster-output`. 1.1 adds each Worker's `description` and `derived` line, and each step's `since` and `summary`. 1.2 adds each Worker's `liveness`, its runs whose liveness needs a look. 1.3 adds each Worker's `name` for people, and makes a Worker the engine runs a step on busy whatever load its source reports. 1.4 makes the name `<runtime> · <account> · <role or tier> [<kinds>]` (the runtime's title, the operator's label of an agent account or its masked hint and slot, the kinds of work) and adds an agent account quarantine's `detail`. 1.5 adds a source read's `describing`: a source whose first describe has not landed yet. 1.6 adds each Worker's `teams`: the operator keeps it out of teams. 1.7 adds `now`, capacity now (design/roster.md#capacity-now): each account's windows and whether it takes new work, the free Workers in the order their quota would be lost unused, the Workers whose quota cannot be read (never counted free), the stalled runs, the accounts with no quota left, the Workers that cannot work, and the ready board tasks with the Worker a start would most likely go to; each list at most 16, `more` counting the rest. 1.8 adds each step's `startedBy`: whether dispatch started its run by itself, or the lead or the operator did (PROP-0014 D2). 1.9 adds each free Worker's `headroom` in capacity now, above the operator's reserve, and lets its `resetsAt` be absent when the reading names no reset (PROP-0014 D3).

unknown.description: A fact the roster could not read, and why.
Why the fact is not known: its source is not mounted, could not be read, or does not say; never a default (INV-2).

load.description: The Worker's runtime's load as its source reports it (capability-descriptor@1.3): runs in its slots, queued, and routed to it and not started (pending); Workers of one account report the same numbers.

availability.description: What the roster makes of the Worker's state and its account: ready; busy N of M (running of slots; any run in its slots makes it busy, and it still takes work until they are full; 1.3: a step the engine runs on it makes it busy too, whatever load its source reports); resting at a limit until its reset; unavailable with why; or quarantined (its enrolled agent account is, and the Worker takes no work). `summary` is the one-line form the CLI and the page show.

quarantineDetail.description: 1.4: what the reading that quarantined the account found (agent-account@1.1 `quarantine.detail`), such as the runtime version found and the ones its reader admits.

kind.description: `agent`: an enrolled agent account (agent-account@1.0); `website`: a website account of the catalog.

label.description: The operator's label: a website account's catalog label, an agent account's masked hint. Only an operator-scope caller gets it.

status.description: The record's own status: for an agent account `enrolled`, `ready`, `signed-out`, `quarantined`; for a website account `new`, `ready`, `reauth-required`, `challenge`, `disabled`.

sameAs.description: Website accounts signed in as the same person (none of them takes work).

account.description: The account the Worker runs on, as its descriptor names it (capability-descriptor@1.5), with its record.

record.description: The account's record: the enrolled agent account with this id (or that lists the Worker), else the website account with this id.

liveness.description: 1.2: one run of the Worker whose liveness needs a look, as its source tells it, and the run in one sentence.

work.description: A step of a running workflow run that the Worker runs now, and the board task the run serves.

since.description: 1.1: when the step's current attempt started (its `workflow.node.started` event); unknown when the event log is not mounted, no longer holds it, or past the bound.

summary.description: 1.1: the step in one sentence: the board task it serves, the run's template and id, the step, and for how long it has run; 1.8: and `started by itself` when dispatch started its run.

startedBy.description: 1.8: who started the board task's run: `dispatch` (System by itself, PROP-0014), `lead` (MCP run or task, the CLI), or `operator` (Start on /ui); absent when the engine does not tell.

used.description: The used share of the window, in percent, from its latest reading.

resets.description: When the window resets: the later of its latest reading's resetsAt and cooldownUntil.

pool.description: A pool of the Worker's account on the resource ledger.

unknownUsage.description: Runs in its current window whose usage the ledger could not count and has not counted since (D25), by kind.

describing.description: 1.5: on a silent read, the source has not yet described its Workers once since it registered (its first describe is still running, a start's first probe say): its Workers are not known yet, never known to be none.

name.description: 1.3: a name for people, never an id to route by and never a key. 1.4: its display name, `<runtime> · <account> · <role or tier> [<kinds>]` (for example `Claude Code · science · develop [code]`): the runtime's title, else its provider's first word capitalised (a model Worker's, its family's); the account's label for an operator (an agent account's, else its masked hint and slot; a website account's catalog label, else its id), for a client the slot or the id; with no account, the rest of its own id; its role or tier, and its kinds of work.

description.description: 1.1: what the Worker is for, in the operator's words (capability-descriptor@1.7); unknown when none is configured.

derived.description: 1.1: a line made from its provider, role, and tier, for a reader to show, marked as derived, when there is no description.

role.description: The role it serves on its agent account (account × role); null for a Worker that is no role's.

limits.description: Capabilities a usage limit holds off until a time.

siblings.description: The other Workers of its account.

work.description: The steps it runs now: at most 32, `more` counting the rest; `unread` when the runs read were cut by their bound.

liveness.description: 1.2: its runs whose liveness needs a look (`ctx.workers.liveness`, PROP-0013): stalled, being looked at after their holder stopped, or ended without being known to be gone and holding what they ran in. Present only when its Worker source tells liveness and has such a run of it, or could not tell (unknown).

teams.description: 1.6: that the operator keeps it out of teams (the engine's `teams.excludeWorkers`, D58): it is never a team member and takes every other step, in one sentence. Present only when the engine tells the exclusion and leaves this Worker out, or could not tell (unknown).

capacityWindow.description: 1.7: one window of an account's pool now, as the Worker's pools give it.

capacityAccount.description: 1.7: an account now: its pools' windows, and whether it takes new work now (false at a limit, or when none of its Workers takes work; unknown when its quota cannot be read: no current reading is never read as room), with why in one line.

capacityQuota.description: 1.7: the quota a free Worker has left: its account's window with the least left among those with a current reading; 1.9: its binding window (the one with the least headroom, by the quota score's one headroom rule, T185), `headroom` what is left above the operator's reserve, and `resetsAt` absent when its reading names no reset.

capacityFree.description: 1.7: a Worker that takes work now (ready, its account not at a limit, its quota known). `quota` null: no account quota applies to it (it names no account, or none is tracked for its account).

capacityUnread.description: 1.7: a Worker its source says is ready whose account's quota cannot be read now, and why: never counted as free capacity (INV-2).

capacityStalled.description: 1.7: a stalled agent run of a Worker, since when.

capacityNoQuota.description: 1.7: an account at a limit, and until when (unknown when no reset is known).

capacityCannotWork.description: 1.7: a Worker that takes no work (unavailable or quarantined), with why in one line.

capacityReady.description: 1.7: a ready task of an active board project, and the Worker a start would most likely go to now, as the start preview tells it (the first, in the free order, that could take its first step); null when no Worker that takes work now could.

capacity.description: 1.7: capacity now, made on the server from the roster and the board (design/roster.md#capacity-now). Each list holds at most 16 entries, `more` counting the rest; a list that cannot be made is unknown, with why.

free.description: The Workers that take work now, the one whose quota would be lost unused fastest first (what is left over the minutes to its reset), then the most left, the soonest reset, the id; those no quota applies to last.

quotaUnknown.description: The Workers ready as their source says whose account's quota cannot be read, in id order: never counted free.

stalled.description: The stalled runs, the longest stalled first; `unread` when a Worker's liveness could not be told (never read as none).

noQuota.description: The accounts at a limit, in id order.

cannotWork.description: The Workers that take no work (unavailable or quarantined), in id order.

ready.description: The ready tasks of the active board projects, by project id, each project's oldest first; `unread` when not every active project was read.

workers.description: Every Worker routing lists now, in id order, at most 256.

sources.description: How each Worker source answered its last read: a silent or failed one's Workers are not listed.

unknownUsage.description: usage.unknown entries no pool counts: not valid records, or naming a pool the ledger does not configure.
